mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, code_hash, attempts, verified_token, last_sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE AS recently_sent, (window_started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND sent_count >= 5) AS daily_limit_reached, expires_at <= NOW() AS expired FROM phone_verification WHERE phone = #{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phone_verification (phone, code_hash, attempts, sent_count, window_started_at, last_sent_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{codeHash}, 0, 1, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL 3 MINUTE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sent_count = IF(window_started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY, sent_count + 1, 1), window_started_at = IF(window_started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY, window_started_at, NOW()), code_hash = VALUES(code_hash), attempts = 0, last_sent_at = NOW(), expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL 3 MINUTE, verified_token = NULL, verified_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE phone_verification SET verified_token = #{verifiedToken}, verified_at = NOW(), expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE WHERE id = #{id}
